subject.text: The courier is outside your office

body.text: Our courier is in the lobby. To confirm delivery, reply with the OTP code that was just sent to your phone.
The package will be sent back if you do not reply within 10 minutes.

explanation: A real courier does not need an OTP to deliver a package, and KirimCepat's official domain is kirimcepat.test. The OTP they want is probably for logging in to one of your accounts.
hints: Why would a courier need an OTP code?
Check the sender's domain and the time limit.
